title: Business Systems Developer - Hybrid
description:
Genesis10 is currently seeking a Business Systems Developer for a hybrid position with a Leading Law Firm located in New York, NY. This is a direct hire opportunity requiring 3 days onsite.

We are looking for a high-impact Business Systems Developer who thrives at the intersection of modern intranet engineering, enterprise integration, and workflow automation. In this role, you will help shape and continuously elevate a SharePoint Online hosted intranet, while building the custom applications, APIs, and Power Platform solutions that power how legal professionals collaborate and move work forward. You will partner directly with practice groups, leadership, and IT stakeholders to translate complex legal workflows into secure and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and enhance SharePoint Online intranet solutions using SPFx web parts and extensions with TypeScript, JavaScript, and React
  • Support and enhance the intranet and collaboration sites, including embedded solutions in SharePoint
  • Integrate SharePoint with internal systems and third-party platforms
  • Design and deliver Power Apps, Power Automate workflows, and Power BI dashboards
  • Build secure backend services and APIs using C# and modern .NET
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines and support production systems
  • Collaborate directly with business stakeholders and IT leadership
  • Create secure RESTful APIs and event-driven integrations
  • Consume and integrate REST APIs and Microsoft Graph API to surface data across applications
  • Follow change management, security, and deployment standards (SDLC)
  • Provide training and support to staff on deployed tools and platforms

Requirements:

  • Associate's degree in Computer Science or related field
  • At least 3-5 years' experience building production solutions using SharePoint Online in a professional services or enterprise environment
  • Strong SharePoint Online experience including site administration, information architecture, and content management
  • Hands-on SPFx development with TypeScript and React with strong JavaScript (ES6 ) fundamentals
  • Practical Power Platform experience: Power Apps (canvas/model-driven) and Power Automate with AI applications
  • Experience integrating via REST APIs, Microsoft Graph API, and Microsoft 365 services (Teams, OneDrive, Exchange, Dataverse)
  • Ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical professionals
  • Strong written/verbal communication and exceptional client service skills
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Desired skills:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher
  • Experience in a large law firm
  • Modern .NET (8-10) experience building services and integrations
  • Azure experience (Logic Apps, Functions, App Registrations) and CI/CD with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
  • Experience with legal-specific platforms, such as iManage or similar
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications (PL-400, MS-600, or other Azure/M365/SharePoint)

Pay range: $150,000 - $175,000 per year

Benefits:

In addition to base salary and discretionary bonus(es), a generous employee benefits package is offered including, but not limited to, paid time off, medical, dental, vision care, 401(k) and substantial health club discounts.
